risk_if_not_implemented: Without Flexible Technology Stack, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Alignment With Enterprise Architecture
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop an enterprise architecture, aligned with industry-recognized leading practices, with consideration for security, compliance and resilience principles that addresses risk to organizational operations, assets, individuals and other organizations.
compensating_control_1.justification: Alignment With Enterprise Architecture (SEA-04) provides secure engineering and architectural guidance that compensates for the absence of Flexible Technology Stack (SEA-02.2) by embedding security requirements into design and lifecycle processes as an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Technology Lifecycle Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to manage the usable lifecycles of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Technology Lifecycle Management (AST-37) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Flexible Technology Stack (SEA-02.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
